fields.statement: At 5c8b9d932, verifier ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run RunVerdict -v: TestRunVerdictDowngrade PASS. It journals major->minor and blocker->major with severity and original_severity, and refuses as CodeUsage a downgrade of a major to major, a major or blocker to blocker, one with no severity, one of a minor finding, and a severity on a confirmed verdict. go test -trimpath ./internal/run: ok (TestStandingDowngrade covers the journaled verdict and that a finding downgraded below major no longer stands). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden: ok, and re-running it with -update left no diff, so the golden is current. Diff read: SeverityRank orders blocker<major<minor<nit, and the validation requires rank(new) > rank(original). Note: run.Verdict now decodes original_severity from input, so a confirmed or dropped verdict could carry a caller-supplied one (a downgraded verdict's is overwritten). This is outside the acceptance.
